svg.title: A terminal typing out what this account is for
svg.desc: 👋🏻 Hello World! / 🏗️ Keep the safe way easy / ✂️ Deleting more than I merge / ⏱️ Feedback in under a minute / 🧩 Repos that fit together / 📦 Deciding the rule once / 🪵 The failure in one place / 🗺️ Deployed with one file / 📉 One fewer thing to explain / 🚦 A red test means it stops here / 🚧 No step is waiting on me / 📐 One shape with no surprises / 🧪 Checks that nobody can skip

g.text: 🚦 A red test means it stops here
🚧 No step is waiting on me
